native_context.input_scope: Item index supplied to each original actor-selection branch. No menu or dialogue replay.

records.source_Japanese:
北海周辺でも
育てられる可能性は十分あるな
records.current_English: Could grow around the North Sea.
records.speaker: Hans or Mikhail
records.context: The player requests advice while viewing Pumpkin Seeds. Both advisers use the same reply. This is a standalone observation in the item screen, with no preceding spoken prompt.
records.source_meaning: The seeds have a good chance of growing around the North Sea as well.
records.english: There's a good chance these will grow around the North Sea, too.
records.localization_note: Restore the degree of confidence and the sense that the North Sea is another possibility.

records.source_Japanese:
地中海あたりに持ち込むと
うまく育ちそうじゃな
records.current_English: Ｉ think it would grow well around the Mediterranean.
records.speaker: Hans or Mikhail
records.context: The player requests advice while viewing Tomato Seedling. Both advisers use the same reply. This is a standalone observation in the item screen, with no preceding spoken prompt.
records.source_meaning: The seedling looks likely to grow well if introduced around the Mediterranean.
records.english: I think this would do well around the Mediterranean.
records.localization_note: Use a grower’s natural phrasing and preserve the tentative forecast. Replace the full-width I.

records.source_Japanese:
新大陸やアフリカの熱帯でも
育つかもしれん
records.current_English: May grow in Africa or the New World.
records.speaker: Hans or Mikhail
records.context: The player requests advice while viewing Banana Tree. Both advisers use the same reply. This is a standalone observation in the item screen, with no preceding spoken prompt.
records.source_meaning: The plant might also grow in the tropical parts of the New World and Africa.
records.english: It might grow in the tropics of the New World or Africa, too.
records.localization_note: Restore the tropical climate condition and both regions. Keep the prediction qualified.

records.source_Japanese:
地中海に咲く花で作った蜂蜜も
きっとうまかろう
records.current_English: Honey from Mediterranean flowers must taste good too.
records.speaker: Hans or Mikhail
records.context: The player requests advice while viewing Beehive. Both advisers use the same reply. This is a standalone observation in the item screen, with no preceding spoken prompt.
records.source_meaning: Honey made from flowers that bloom around the Mediterranean must taste good too.
records.english: Honey from Mediterranean flowers must taste good too.
records.localization_note: Retain the speaker’s speculation about flavor and the Mediterranean flowers. The line works as a light aside about the hive.

records.source_Japanese:
中国ではサメのヒレを
地中海の奥の黒海周辺では
サメの卵を食べると聞くぞ
records.current_English: Ｉ hear they eat shark fins in China and shark eggs around the Black Sea, beyond the Mediterranean.
records.speaker: Hans or Mikhail
records.context: The player requests advice while viewing Baby Shark. Both advisers use the same reply. This is a standalone observation in the item screen, with no preceding spoken prompt.
records.source_meaning: The adviser has heard that people eat shark fins in China and shark eggs around the Black Sea beyond the Mediterranean.
records.english: I hear they eat shark fins in China and shark eggs around the Black Sea beyond the Mediterranean.
records.localization_note: Keep the reported food customs, the fins and eggs, and both regions. Use ordinary ASCII I and run the geographic qualifier directly after Black Sea.

records.source_Japanese:
東南アジアはコショウを育てるのに
絶好の気候じゃな
records.current_English: Southeast Asia has the perfect climate for growing pepper.
records.speaker: Hans or Mikhail
records.context: The player requests advice while viewing Pepper Plant. Both advisers use the same reply. This is a standalone observation in the item screen, with no preceding spoken prompt.
records.source_meaning: Southeast Asia has an ideal climate for growing pepper.
records.english: Southeast Asia's climate is perfect for growing pepper.
records.localization_note: Keep Southeast Asia and the ideal climate in one natural spoken observation.

records.source_Japanese:
東南アジアの気候はチョウジを
育てるのにとても適しておる
地中海では…
難しいかもしれんのう？
records.current_English: Southeast Asia's climate is ideal for cloves. The Mediterranean might prove difficult...
records.speaker: Hans or Mikhail
records.context: The player requests advice while viewing Clove Plant. Both advisers use the same reply. This is a standalone observation in the item screen, with no preceding spoken prompt.
records.source_meaning: Southeast Asia is very well suited to cloves. The adviser pauses to consider the Mediterranean and suggests it may be difficult.
records.english: Southeast Asia is ideal for cloves. The Mediterranean, though? We might have trouble there.
records.localization_note: State the favorable climate plainly. The short Mediterranean question keeps the change of thought and the tentative conclusion.

records.source_Japanese:
地中海でシナモンが生産できたら
大儲けじゃな
records.current_English: We'd make a fortune if we could grow cinnamon in the Mediterranean.
records.speaker: Hans or Mikhail
records.context: The player requests advice while viewing Cinnamon Tree. Both advisers use the same reply. This is a standalone observation in the item screen, with no preceding spoken prompt.
records.source_meaning: If we could produce cinnamon in the Mediterranean, we would make a great profit.
records.english: We'd make a fortune if we could grow cinnamon in the Mediterranean.
records.localization_note: Retain the conversational excitement and the conditional promise of profit.

records.source_Japanese:
アフリカでこの香料を
商品化できればのう
records.current_English: Ｉf only we could market this aromatic product in Africa...
records.speaker: Hans or Mikhail
records.context: The player requests advice while viewing Pimento Plant. Both advisers use the same reply. This is a standalone observation in the item screen, with no preceding spoken prompt.
records.source_meaning: The adviser wishes this aromatic spice could be made into a trade good in Africa.
records.english: If only we could sell this spice in Africa...
records.localization_note: Use the item context to name the spice and keep the wish trailing off. Remove the stiff “market this aromatic product” and the full-width I.

records.source_Japanese:
新大陸ならコーヒーを生産するのに
適しておるはずじゃ
records.current_English: The New World should be well suited to growing coffee.
records.speaker: Hans or Mikhail
records.context: The player requests advice while viewing Coffee Tree. Both advisers use the same reply. This is a standalone observation in the item screen, with no preceding spoken prompt.
records.source_meaning: The New World ought to be suitable for growing coffee.
records.english: The New World should be well suited to growing coffee.
records.localization_note: Retain the confident but qualified growing advice and the named region.

records.source_Japanese:
アフリカあたりでも
茶を作ることはできそうじゃな
records.current_English: Ｉt looks as though we could grow tea in Africa too.
records.speaker: Hans or Mikhail
records.context: The player requests advice while viewing Tea Plant. Both advisers use the same reply. This is a standalone observation in the item screen, with no preceding spoken prompt.
records.source_meaning: It seems possible to produce tea around Africa as well.
records.english: I think we could grow tea in Africa, too.
records.localization_note: Keep the tentative recommendation and the alternative region in direct speech. Replace the full-width I.

records.source_Japanese:
これは、熱帯でしか育たぬようじゃ
アフリカに持ち込んでみては
どうかのう？
records.current_English: This apparently needs tropical conditions to grow. Why not try taking it to Africa?
records.speaker: Hans or Mikhail
records.context: The player requests advice while viewing Cacao Seeds. Both advisers use the same reply. This is a standalone observation in the item screen, with no preceding spoken prompt.
records.source_meaning: This appears to grow only in the tropics. The adviser suggests trying to bring it to Africa.
records.english: This apparently needs tropical conditions to grow. Why not try taking it to Africa?
records.localization_note: Retain the two-part observation and proposal. The tropical requirement and the suggested next step both read clearly.

records.source_Japanese:
地中海で育てて売るとよさそうじゃ
大金持ちになれるかもしれんな
records.current_English: Growing this in the Mediterranean and selling it seems promising. We might become very wealthy.
records.speaker: Hans or Mikhail
records.context: The player requests advice while viewing Tobacco Plant. Both advisers use the same reply. This is a standalone observation in the item screen, with no preceding spoken prompt.
records.source_meaning: Growing and selling this in the Mediterranean looks promising and might make us rich.
records.english: We could grow and sell this in the Mediterranean. Might make us rich, too.
records.localization_note: Keep the location, the plan and the gleeful speculation as a spoken follow-up.

records.source_Japanese:
アフリカの鉱石が
新しい産物になるかもしれん
records.current_English: African ore could be a new product.
records.speaker: Hans or Mikhail
records.context: The player requests advice while viewing Alchemy Book. Both advisers use the same reply. This is a standalone observation in the item screen, with no preceding spoken prompt.
records.source_meaning: Ore from Africa might yield a new local product.
records.english: We might be able to turn African ore into a new trade good.
records.localization_note: Keep the clue about African ore and the uncertain new trade good. Leave the product unidentified.

records.source_Japanese:
アフリカや東アジアでは
ガラスは貴重品じゃのう
records.current_English: Ｉn Africa and East Asia, glass is valuable.
records.speaker: Hans or Mikhail
records.context: The player requests advice while viewing Glassmaking Guide. Both advisers use the same reply. This is a standalone observation in the item screen, with no preceding spoken prompt.
records.source_meaning: Glass is valuable in Africa and East Asia.
records.english: Glass is prized in Africa and East Asia.
records.localization_note: Keep both markets and render the adviser’s observation in a short spoken sentence. Replace the full-width I.

records.source_Japanese: 絹は昔から東アジアの主力商品じゃ
records.current_English: Silk has long been one of East Asia's main trade goods.
records.speaker: Hans or Mikhail
records.context: The player requests advice while viewing Silkworms. Both advisers use the same reply. This is a standalone observation in the item screen, with no preceding spoken prompt.
records.source_meaning: Silk has long been a major trade good in East Asia.
records.english: Silk has long been one of East Asia's main trade goods.
records.localization_note: Retain the historical perspective and the importance of silk in East Asian trade.

records.source_Japanese:
北海や地中海の織物産業は
まだまだ発展する余地があるわい
records.current_English: The textile industries of the North Sea and Mediterranean still have plenty of room to grow.
records.speaker: Hans or Mikhail
records.context: The player requests advice while viewing Loom. Both advisers use the same reply. This is a standalone observation in the item screen, with no preceding spoken prompt.
records.source_meaning: Textile production around the North Sea and Mediterranean still has plenty of potential to grow.
records.english: The textile industries of the North Sea and Mediterranean still have plenty of room to grow.
records.localization_note: Retain the plain idiom “room to grow” and both regions.

records.source_Japanese:
東アジアでも
真珠が採れるかもしれんのう
records.current_English: Perhaps we could find pearls in East Asia too.
records.speaker: Hans or Mikhail
records.context: The player requests advice while viewing Pearl Oyster. Both advisers use the same reply. This is a standalone observation in the item screen, with no preceding spoken prompt.
records.source_meaning: Pearls may be obtainable in East Asia as well.
records.english: Perhaps we could find pearls in East Asia too.
records.localization_note: Retain the tentative suggestion and the implication that East Asia is another possible source.

records.source_Japanese:
中国には珍しい漢方薬が
まだまだあると聞くぞ
records.current_English: Ｉ hear there are still many unusual herbal medicines in China.
records.speaker: Hans or Mikhail
records.context: The player requests advice while viewing Herbalist's Bible. Both advisers use the same reply. This is a standalone observation in the item screen, with no preceding spoken prompt.
records.source_meaning: The adviser has heard that China still has many unusual traditional medicinal preparations.
records.english: I hear there are plenty more unusual herbal remedies in China.
records.localization_note: Keep the report attributed and preserve “plenty more.” The setting and the item make the tradition clear. Replace the full-width I.

records.source_Japanese:
東南アジアには珍しい果物が
たくさんあるが
この皮からは染料がとれるんじゃよ
records.current_English:
Southeast Asia has rare fruit whose
  peel yields dye.
records.speaker: Hans or Mikhail
records.context: The player requests advice while viewing Mangosteen Seeds. Both advisers use the same reply. This is a standalone observation in the item screen, with no preceding spoken prompt.
records.source_meaning: Southeast Asia has many unusual fruits, and the peel of the fruit under discussion yields dye.
records.english: Southeast Asia has all sorts of unusual fruit. You can make dye from the peel of this one.
records.localization_note: Restore the contrast between regional variety and this fruit’s specific use.

records.source_Japanese:
ネズミが発生したときには
大活躍してくれるはずじゃ
records.current_English: This should prove very useful if we have a rat infestation.
records.speaker: Hans or Mikhail
records.context: The player requests advice while viewing Golden Cat. Both advisers use the same reply. This is a standalone observation in the item screen, with no preceding spoken prompt.
records.source_meaning: The item should prove especially useful if rats appear.
records.english: If rats get aboard, this should come in mighty handy.
records.localization_note: Keep the strong recommendation conditional and give the older adviser a conversational turn of phrase.

records.source_Japanese:
航海する以上は壊血病に備えて
必ず持っておきたい品じゃな
records.current_English:
Every voyage should carry this
  against scurvy.
records.speaker: Hans or Mikhail
records.context: The player requests advice while viewing Lime Drops. Both advisers use the same reply. This is a standalone observation in the item screen, with no preceding spoken prompt.
records.source_meaning: This is something the adviser would always take on a voyage to guard against scurvy.
records.english: I wouldn't set sail without some of this to ward off scurvy.
records.localization_note: Make the recommendation sound like practical experience. Keep scurvy prevention and the insistence on bringing it.

records.source_Japanese:
どんな船乗りも
天候にだけは逆らえん
きっと重宝するじゃろう
records.current_English: No sailor can defy the weather. This is sure to come in handy.
records.speaker: Hans or Mikhail
records.context: The player requests advice while viewing Hermes' Prayer. Both advisers use the same reply. This is a standalone observation in the item screen, with no preceding spoken prompt.
records.source_meaning: Even the best sailor cannot prevail against the weather, so this should be useful.
records.english: No sailor can defy the weather. This is sure to come in handy.
records.localization_note: Retain the natural maxim and the confident recommendation. The source gives no detailed weather effect here.

records.source_Japanese:
東洋医学の神秘じゃな
特に伝染病によく効くそうじゃ
records.current_English: A marvel of Eastern medicine. They say it works especially well against infectious diseases.
records.speaker: Hans or Mikhail
records.context: The player requests advice while viewing Hua Tuo's Tonic. Both advisers use the same reply. This is a standalone observation in the item screen, with no preceding spoken prompt.
records.source_meaning: The adviser admires this example of Eastern medicine and says it reportedly works particularly well against infectious disease.
records.english: A marvel of Eastern medicine. They say it works especially well against infectious diseases.
records.localization_note: Retain the admiring reaction and the reported, qualified remedy claim.

findings: Let the shark remark use the available first row.
Avoid leaving the demonstrative of a new sentence at the end of the previous row.
Give the fruit opening room before the distinction about its peel.
Keep the two reported customs and the geographic qualifier on three complete rows.
Fill the opening rows of the pimento, tea, cacao and pearl remarks without changing their words.
